LightningComponentBundle.description: Custom UI component that allows you to update custom fields on the quote line item.

property.name: transactionLineId
property.label: Line Item ID
property.description: Enter the ID of the transaction line to configure.

property.name: currentTransactionLineId
property.label: Current Line Item ID
property.description: The ID of the transaction line to launch the configurator.

property.name: salesTransactionItems
property.label: Sales Transaction Items
property.description: A collection of Apex ProductConfig__SalesTransactionItem records that contain sales transaction item details.

property.name: showQuoteLineSection
property.label: Show Quote Line section
property.description: When true, displays the Update Quote Line Item Fields section.

property.name: showTermSection
property.label: Show Term section
property.description: When true, displays the Update Terms section.
